bibl.title: P. Brem. 48: A New Date and Context.
bibl.seg: Noah Hacham & Tal Ilan, P. Brem. 48: A New Date and Context.
bibl.note: P. Brem. 48 (to be dated 30th October 116) testifies that Alexandria was still at war in the autumn of 116. The defeat of the Jews cannot be dated to before the end of 116 or the beginning of 117 CE.
